DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.gov.ph DILG OPINION No. 52 s. 2022 June 14, 2022 ATTY. BRENDALE S. BAYALAS City Legal Officer City of Tangub Province of Misamis Occidental Dear Atty. Bayalas: This has reference to your letter seeking clarification from this Department on whether social welfare services, such as the financial assistance and donation programs of the city are exempted from the Commission on Election (COMELEC) ban on disbursement of public funds during the campaign period. Per your letter, the City of Tangub, through its City Social Welfare and Development Office (CSWDO) and the City Mayor's Office, have established financial assistance and donation programs, respectively, in line with its mandate under Section 17 of the Local Government Code of 1991. You also represented that the city prioritizes the uninterrupted rendition of these social welfare services as it acknowledges the urgent and exigent nature of the needs addressed by these programs. Hence, the herein request for clarification. May it be respectfully informed that the issue raised herein has already been discussed and settled in DILG Legal Opinion No. 37, S. 20221, pertinent portion of which reads: "The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) issued Resolution Number 10747 dated December 16, 2021. prohibiting the release of any public funds startinq March 25. 2022 until Mav 8. 2022 except for limited purposes. Section 2 of the said Resolution provides: "Section 2. Prohibition on Release, Disbursement or Expenditure of Public Funds. — Effective March 25, 2022 until May 8, 2022, no public official or employee, including barangay officials, and those of government-owned or controlled corporations and their subsidiaries, shall release, disburse, or expend any public funds for: x xxx 1 May 16, 2022 "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline Nc: 8876-34-54

3. The Department for Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) and any other office. aqency, or bureau in other departments of the qovernment performinq functions similar to said department, except for salaries of personnel, and for such other expenses as the Commission may authorize after due notice and hearing. x x x x" (emphasis supplied) We submit that providing financial assistance and donations to the constituents within the period specified in COMELEC Resolution No. 10747is prohibited and may constitutes an election offense penalized under Section 21 thereof, viz: "Section 21. Penalty — Any violation of the provisions of this Resolution shall, consistent with Sections 261 and 264 of the Omnibus Election Code, constitute an election offense and shall be punishable by imprisonment of not less than one (1) year but not more than six (6) years, among other penalties for by law." A copy of the aforesaid DILG Legal Opinion No. 37, S. 2022 is hereto attached for ease of reference. As such, social welfare services, such as giving of financial assistance and donation programs are not exempted from the COMELEC ban on disbursement of public funds during the campaign period. Be that as it may, this opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts We hope to have sufficiently addressed your concerns. Thank you. Very respectfully yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ¯.fJK!
